{{Quote|In the name of the Empire, the personnel on this station and all ships in the area are under arrest. Cease your flight, and return to the platform at once or be destroyed.|The Imperialization of Azzameen Home Base|audio=HomeBaseImp-XWA.flac|<ref name="Alliance" />}}
As a result of the [[Azzameen family]]'s actions against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the Imperial-aligned [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] company [[Viraxo Industries]], a competitor to the Azzameens' [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] trading company, the Galactic Empire issued warrants for the arrest of the members of the Azzameen family as well as the [[Imperialization/Legends|seizure]] of all Azzameen property. This '''Imperialization of Azzameen assets''' took place shortly after the [[Battle of Hospital]], in which the Azzameens had taken place alongside the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Imperial action saw the family's home base, [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]], and their company's [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|repair facility]] captured after a brief skirmish with Azzameen forces.
